character.name: Cat Hero
character.summary: Chunky black house cat, big head, short legs, heavy paws. Same cat as the current atlas, with a much wider acting range. No props, no clothes — the silhouette does the talking.
character.style: 16-bit pixel art, 1px ink outline, flat fills with 2-step shading, no anti-aliasing, no gradient

canvas.hitbox_note: Body must fit inside 34x42 above the foot line. Tail, ears and swipe arc may overflow. The cat is drawn at 87x66 today and that footprint is the ceiling.

animations.name: idle
animations.notes: breathing loop, tail tip flickers on frame 3

animations.name: walk
animations.notes: 6-frame cycle with a proper contact/passing/lift on each side

animations.name: run
animations.notes: body pitched forward, both paws off the ground on 2 frames

animations.name: jump
animations.notes: frame chosen by velocity: rise (vy<-120), apex, fall (vy>200)

animations.name: cling
animations.notes: NEW. claws dug into wall, body vertical to wall, ears back, 2-frame grip shift

animations.name: walljump
animations.notes: NEW. push-off then a small flip; 0.12s one-shot

animations.name: swipe
animations.notes: wind-up, contact, follow-through; arc may overflow the hitbox

animations.name: hurt
animations.notes: NEW. eyes shut, ears flat, knocked back

animations.name: land
animations.notes: NEW. soft and hard variants; squash on frame 1

wall_cling.trigger: airborne, pressing toward a solid wall, vy > 0
wall_cling.effect: fall speed clamped to 120 px/s while held

acceptance: 36 frames, one per cell, no empty or duplicated cells
body inside 34x42 above the foot line; feet touch the foot line
all opaque pixels are Apollo colours (tolerance 0)
no anti-aliasing, no drop shadow, no background
black and grey skins share identical poses and timing
